# `oaap edge`

forward hostnames from this edge node to other nodes (RFC-0006).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap edge [--port PORT] {add,remove,list} [hostname] [target]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `hostname` | -- |
| `target` | -- |
| `--port PORT` | target platform's HTTP port (default 80) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `add` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
